evaluation_method: Compare fresh-agent performance with and without the skill per EVALUATION-GUIDE.md.

cases.name: Marked-only NDA vs real disclosure practice
cases.query: Review this NDA before our technical deep-dive meetings with a potential partner. We'll be walking them through our architecture verbally and screen-sharing unmarked docs.
files: NDA protecting only information 'marked Confidential at the time of disclosure', no oral-disclosure catch-up mechanism, 3-year blanket term
baseline_risks: Summarizes the NDA as standard; the marked-only trap versus the client's verbal/unmarked disclosure plan goes unnoticed
expected_behavior: Tests the definition against the stated disclosure plan: verbal walkthroughs and unmarked docs fall outside protection
Flags the missing oral-disclosure written-summary mechanism
Flags the 3-year blanket limit as a trade-secret hazard for counsel
Concrete fixes proposed as negotiation points
must_not: Call the NDA adequate for the described disclosure practice

cases.name: Personal data with no DPA
cases.query: Review the confidentiality terms of this customer-support outsourcing agreement. The vendor's agents will access our EU users' account data.
files: agreement with a decent confidentiality clause but no DPA, no breach-notice obligation, no subprocessor terms, no deletion obligation
baseline_risks: Reviews only the confidentiality clause; the personal-data machinery gap is missed, or GDPR compliance is opined on directly
expected_behavior: Recognizes personal-data processing is in scope; runs the machinery checklist
Flags the missing DPA, breach-notice, subprocessor, and deletion terms as material gaps
Flags for counsel rather than declaring the agreement non-compliant with GDPR
must_not: Ignore the data-protection machinery because the confidentiality clause looks fine

cases.name: Asymmetric 'mutual' NDA
cases.query: This is a mutual NDA for our partnership talks — confirm it protects both sides equally.
files: NDA where the counterparty's information is protected for 5 years with strict care, while the client's is protected 2 years with reasonable care, and the independent-development exception applies only against the client's information
baseline_risks: Confirms 'mutual and equal' from the title
expected_behavior: Runs the symmetry check clause by clause
Surfaces the duration (5 vs 2 years), care standard, and one-sided exception asymmetries with citations
Ranks the asymmetries and proposes mirror-image fixes

cases.name: Broad exception + residuals combo
cases.query: Our counterparty says their standard NDA is 'very protective'. Review it for us as the disclosing party.
files: NDA with a 'previously known to Recipient' exception requiring no written evidence, plus a residuals clause permitting use of anything retained in unaided memory
baseline_risks: Accepts the 'very protective' framing; the no-proof exception and residuals clause that together gut protection go unflagged
expected_behavior: Audits the exceptions: prior-knowledge with no written-records burden is near-unfalsifiable
Surfaces the residuals clause and explains how the combination hollows know-how protection
Rates the NDA weak for a discloser, with citations and fixes
must_not: Endorse the NDA as protective while the exception/residuals combo undermines it

cases.name: Non-compete question
cases.query: Can my former employer enforce the 2-year non-compete in my old employment agreement?
baseline_risks: Skill could analyze confidentiality when the question is a restrictive covenant
expected_behavior: Recognizes a non-compete enforceability question; routes to restrictive-covenants-review and counsel
must_not: Produce a confidentiality review for a non-compete question
